obligations.title: Epoch-aware offset round trip
obligations.input_scope: every u32 epoch and every u64 scan index through token_digits/parse_digits (the core encode_ep/parse_ep wrap); fixed 26 digits, loops unwound to 40 with unwinding checks on

expect.property: epoch and position survive the round trip

obligations.title: Offset successor, START sentinel, and exhaustion
obligations.input_scope: START and every u64 scan index including u64::MAX, with every u32 epoch through the digit codec

expect.property: a token resumes at the index it was issued for
a position resumes at its own index

obligations.title: Offset encoding injectivity and ordering
obligations.input_scope: two symbolic (u32 epoch, u64 scan index) tuples; byte order of the 26 digits (which is String order) against tuple order

obligations.title: Producer stale-epoch and new-epoch admission
obligations.input_scope: decide_producer over every u64 request/current epoch and sequence, every remembered offset and 16-byte hash, present or absent current state and request hash, every tail next/closed value, and all three sealed states; producer id fixed empty (not an input)

expect.property: a new epoch must start at sequence 0

obligations.title: Producer duplicate, conflict, and replay-result semantics
obligations.input_scope: every same-epoch request at or below the remembered sequence, with every stored offset (including the u64::MAX legacy sentinel), every stored hash (including all-zero), present or absent request hash, every tail and sealed state

expect.property: a duplicate is answered, not admitted or refused
a known hash conflict at the remembered sequence is refused
a duplicate is answered, not admitted or refused

obligations.title: Producer sequence gaps and numeric exhaustion
obligations.input_scope: every same-epoch request above the remembered sequence (so the remembered sequence is below u64::MAX), plus every request against a lane remembered at u64::MAX; all tails, hashes and sealed states

expect.property: the adjacent sequence is admitted unless the collection is closed
a sequence beyond the successor is a gap naming the successor

obligations.title: Seal generation authorization truth table
obligations.input_scope: seal_authorized over every u64 fence, every Option<u64> generation and both closing flags

expect.property: a tagged operation is authorized exactly at or above the fence
an untagged close is refused once a fence exists

obligations.title: Final-append error disposition
obligations.input_scope: every AppendErr variant (enumeration pinned by an exhaustive match) with symbolic numeric payloads and symbolic segment/materialized inputs to the product translation; string payloads empty (neither classifier reads them)

expect.property: the raw surface follows the contract
the product surface agrees with the raw surface

obligations.title: Commit groups, dependency barriers, and observable replies
obligations.input_scope: one stream; requests drawn from A (final producer append), R (its retry), X (plain append), Y (same producer seq, other hash), S (Y retry) and C (producer-less empty close); shapes small {A,R,X}, requests {A,R,X,Y}, requests-faults {A,R,X,Y}, faults {A,R,X} with 2 restarts, close {A,R,C} and refusal-retry {A,Y,S}; at most 2 restarts, 1 fatal WAL failure, 1 group failure (a db.write error before or after apply, or a pre-write reject; pinned SlateDB order: default reads stay open until closed_result is written after a post-apply error) and 1 external retirement; any grouping of the committer channel; only the producer-row staging read is modelled; safety only, no symmetry

obligations.title: Commit handoff, retirement, and already-durable completion
obligations.input_scope: one engine; 3 requests (2 writers, 1 no-write verdict) for small and liveness, 4 requests (2 writers) for expanded; 1 fatal WAL failure; 1 group failure (a db.write error before or after apply, or a pre-write reject); 1 or 2 external retirements; 1 committer abort; requester cancellation; pinned post-apply read window; liveness with weak fairness on the committer, the completer, the acker close, stranded rejection, WAL landing and durable_seq reporting only; no symmetry

obligations.title: Serving possession, owner fencing, and shard movement
obligations.input_scope: CONDITIONAL DESIGN CHECK: write authority rests on ASM-SLATEDB-FENCE, which rests on the unestablished ASM-OBJSTORE-CAS; two nodes, one shard prefix, one stream; fleet mode with 1 override move and stale per-node views, or single (no-ring) mode; A and R (small), A, R and X with 2 attempts of R (expanded), or A, R and X (single); 3 engine incarnations; 1 node crash (the restart bootstraps with no ring); 1 ambiguous WAL PUT; abandoned storage closes and crashed PUTs landing later; one request per committer group; safety only, no symmetry

obligations.title: History absorption, publication, and safe hot-data trimming
obligations.owner: history absorber (gather, lane marks, the settled plan-time rollback of a stranded mark, the dirty-index rescan and the sweep prune), shard committer maintenance (absorbed-advance retirement from the stream's own boundary, trims, byte ledger), the settlement receipts, the postings warm install and the postings index admission of overlapping pages
obligations.input_scope: one stream incarnation, 3 one-byte record offsets (1 durable at Init, 2 appends) with routing keys K1, K1, K2, or 4 offsets (K1, K1, K2, K1; 3 appends) in the page shape; per-stream gather cap 2 records (small, ledger, liveness, cache-cap2, page, overlap witnesses, scan probe) or 1 record (expanded, cache); gathers by one Remote scan over the snapshot taken when it starts (small, ledger, liveness, overlap witnesses) or by that scan or the durable ring (expanded, cache, page); up to 2 (small) or 3 (expanded) applied-not-durable commit groups; up to 2 AbsorbedBatch messages in flight (3 in the scan probe), each carrying the chunk start and byte count of its copy and a settlement receipt that a group retiring an Exact advance holds until dispatch has published its tails, and every other advance drops at staging; the committer retires an advance only from the stream's own boundary (Exact, Detached, Diverged); a plan rolls a stranded lane mark back only while the stream's bucket is settled; a pending-roster flag that signals, the gather outcome and the seeding-only dirty-index rescan update; the sweep prune for evictable handles, not gated on settlement (all shapes but the page shape, liveness-refusal keeps it); a bucket-sharing stream toggled by the environment (ledger-small, the mate witness only); 1 crash, 1 failed or ambiguous history flush and 1 refused group or dropped op (small, expanded, ledger-small); 2 refused groups, one of which may be a dropped op, and 1 failed or ambiguous flush, with no crash or prune (page); 1 crash and 1 refused group with the prune (page-regather); 1 refused group or dropped op (liveness-refusal); none in the ledger-overlap, cache and liveness shapes; 1 (small) or 2 (expanded) reader snapshots; per-operation trim allowances {0,1,3}; postings-slice cache with 1 weight eviction and cold loads (cache shapes only); postings pages per routing key as (first offset, offsets) under the (key, first offset) page key, with the reader's admission of overlapping pages that agree over their common span (page shapes, the overlap witnesses and the scan probe only); liveness with bounded faults and fairness on actor attempts only, the rescan included. No symmetry, no state or action constraints.

obligations.title: Exact composition of history, hot storage, and read visibility
obligations.owner: merged read path: execute_segment, the absorption race check, the durable resume cursor and the provisional continuation
obligations.input_scope: one stream incarnation and segment, 3 offsets with routing keys K1, K2, K1 and sizes 3, 1, 1 bytes, page request 2 bytes (the first record exceeds a page); durable and applied visibility, keyed (K1) and unfiltered reads; small shapes: 3 records durable at Init, 4 pages; expanded shapes: 1 durable record and 2 appends during the reads, 5 pages; up to 2 applied-not-durable commit groups; 1 ownership move; race-check loop bound 2 (production 16); trim allowances {0,1,3}; durable tail ring (durable mode); corrupt postings and short postings windows (keyed); history read errors on the current engine (small shapes); applied-mode provisional continuations bound to the serving engine (writer epoch) and an observation digest, verified by a re-read on another engine or refused with the durable recovery cursor, and V2 positions refused past the durable frontier (applied expanded shapes, keyed and unfiltered); the probes lose a durable postings page or canonical row. No symmetry, no state or action constraints.

obligations.title: Reachability-based garbage collection and reader/fork protection
obligations.owner: history-partition GC settings and read view, and fork-reference retention and release
obligations.input_scope: ReachGC: one history partition with objects L1 (committed L0), L2 (a later flush: upload, then manifest commit), C (one compaction output) and O (a fenced writer's orphan L0); one absorbed boundary over 2 offsets; one tick stands for 300 s; the compactor checkpoints the pre-compaction manifest for 3 ticks (1 tick in the timing-lapse shape); the writer Db's in-memory manifest view is refreshed within 1 tick of going stale and a production read ends within 1 tick of starting; one collector pass per tick; min_age 1 tick, writers active to tick 2, clock to 4 (small, lapse), or min_age 2, clock to 5 with one upstream checkpoint pin (expanded); liveness with writer and pin activity ending at tick 2 and weak fairness on the clock, the collector steps and the end of a read. ForkPin: one source name with 2 incarnations; safety and witnesses with 3 fork-child incarnations (F3 recreates F1's name after F1's tombstone), liveness with 2 (distinct names, or one recreated name); creator installs racing child deletion, source deletion and recreation, 1 request crash (creator or DELETE); the write-ahead fork-debt marker, the background reconciler (weakly fair per marker in the reconciler liveness checks) and client DELETE retries (weakly fair only in the client-retry liveness check); legacy shapes where deletes before the rollout write no marker, the one-time backfill indexes them, and a child name may be recreated over such a tombstone before or after the rollout (the recreate CAS indexes the debt it overwrites; debt the old binary overwrote before the rollout is excluded from the properties). No symmetry, no state or action constraints.

obligations.title: Registry CAS, attempt-local outcomes, and incarnation fencing
obligations.input_scope: Two projects share one stream name (two descriptor paths). Small: M1 and M2 race generation allocations on (P1, n) incarnation E1 while D tombstones E1 and recreates the same name and key as E2; M5, validated against E2, races them on the replacement; M3 allocates on (P2, n) at E3; every E1 mutator may start before, during or after the delete and recreate; 2 attempts per call; generations <= 3; one lost PUT reply, one failed dispatch, one missing ETag, one failed GET, one client retry of an ambiguous recreate. Expanded: three E1 racers (M1, M2, M4) and two E2 racers (M5, M6) on one name, the production bound of 5 attempts, two lost replies, two failed dispatches, two missing ETags, one failed GET, one recreate retry. A conditional PUT is one request (src/bootstrap/s3_store.rs sends conditional requests with max_retries 0), so a committed PUT is never answered Precondition. Evidence properties: UniqueAllocation, IncarnationFenced, AllocatorCountsWrites, RecreateAnswerTruthful. AttemptLocalResult and NegativeOutcomesWroteNothing hold by construction (ASM-SEAL-DECIDE-FN).

obligations.title: Seal claims, renewal, and competing takeover reservations
obligations.owner: seal coordinator (application::lifecycle) and the shard committer's seal fence
obligations.input_scope: One incarnation, one segment. P0: the original product seal-with-final (two handler slots: original and exact retry); T1: a competing product seal-with-final; T2: a plain :seal. Layouts: one instance, or two instances with P0's exact retry on B while A owns the shard at start. Safety: generations <= 5 (<= 6 expanded) by CONSTRAINT; MaxClaimLoop = 0 (unbounded restarts, any of which may give up: a superset of the production six-iteration loop). small: 1 crash; faults: 1 registry fault, 1 cancellation, 1 enqueue failure; expanded: 1 crash, 1 registry fault; xproc: two instances, 1 crash (crash failover); retire: 1 crash, 1 engine replacement, 1 failed fence-row read; engine: two instances, 1 crash, 1 engine replacement (a stranded head group may become durable while answered Moved), plus HandlersProgress. Baselines stage and make durable each committer element in one step (MaxHeldFence = 0), except xproc-held, retire-held and liveness-held, which separate them for one fence group: it may become durable, be lost with its engine, or be rejected without an engine retirement. Liveness (LiveSpec, one instance, no constraint, no symmetry, MaxClaimLoop = 6, weak fairness on the committer, handler steps, lease time and T2's issue): T2 retries forever; small = P0 one request, 1 crash, 1 engine replacement; contenders = P0 and T1 one request each, 1 engine replacement; faults = P0 one request, 1 registry fault, 1 enqueue failure, 1 cancellation, 1 timeout.

obligations.title: Final-record sealing, ambiguous append outcomes, and owed debt
obligations.owner: seal coordinator final-record path: raw close-with-content and product seal-with-final
obligations.input_scope: One incarnation, one segment; operation ids, producer lanes and request hashes derived from (surface, content, coordination); validity is a function of the request and the handling instance's record ceiling and ingest capacity; generations <= 5 (CONSTRAINT); MaxClaimLoop = 0. A: raw close-with-content X on client producer (L, 1), two requests; raw appends N0 = (L, 0) and N1 = (L, 1) with X's bytes; plain S; 1 crash, 1 cancellation, 1 timeout (expanded: also 1 registry fault, 1 enqueue failure). A2: X on two concurrent slots, the retry on instance B; 1 engine replacement, 1 enqueue failure; plus HandlersProgress. B: raw X (two concurrent slots) and product Y with the same bytes and different coordination, plain S. C: B with X on the product surface. P: product final X on client (L, 0), product append N1 and raw append N2 on the same tuple and bytes, plain S. SL: raw X and product Y without producer headers and with the same bytes (one synthetic lane), plain S. PW: product final X on (L, 0), product append N1 on the same tuple, raw close-with-content W admitted while X's claim stands (X's claim can be released without a lapse). V: one instance; raw X, two requests; product Y over the record ceiling; product Z refused before intent. V4: X's retry on B over B's ingest capacity. V5: X's retry on B over B's record ceiling, B owns the shard at start, 1 engine replacement, three X requests, plain S. V5A: V5 with A owning the shard at start (the original commits before the retry reaches a committer). VP: V5 for product Y. OP: raw close-with-content X and a raw append N1 without Stream-Closed, both without producer headers and with the same bytes (N1 has X's semantic operation id), plain S, 1 crash, 1 cancellation. Exact retries at every persisted boundary. Every baseline checks SealingRefusesNewAppends (L4). No TLA-003 liveness (renewal generations are unbounded).
